products.product_description: Woodstock All Natural Tamari Almonds, 7.5 OZ in a gusseted re-sealable poly bag.
products.product_quantity: 67 cases, each containing 8 packages per shipping case
products.reason_for_recall: Undeclared soy ingredient on mislabeled back panel. While the Tamari Almonds contain soy, the ingredient statement does not include soy. In addition, the nutrition facts and UPC# are incorrect which corresponds to another almond product. People who have an allergy or severe sensitivity to soy run the risk of serious or life-threatening allergic reaction if they consume this product.
